title: Scoring systems for the prediction of choledocholithiasis: systematic review and meta-analysis
author: Jun Watanabe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bm7xk9pn

steps.title: Define Study Inclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Identify studies for inclusion based on specific participant and model criteria.

substeps.instruction: Include studies on the development, update, and/or external validation of at least one multivariable model or scoring system for predicting choledocholithiasis.
Ensure the multivariable model is a mathematical equation relating multiple predictors to the probability of choledocholithiasis in participants with suspected choledocholithiasis.
Include adults aged >18 years with suspected choledocholithiasis in any setting.
Include full-text reports, abstracts, and unpublished data regardless of publication language.
Exclude studies that identify risk factors for choledocholithiasis but do not provide a score.

steps.title: Perform Electronic Database Searches
steps.instruction: Search electronic databases and clinical trial registers using specific search strings to identify relevant studies.

substeps.instruction: Search Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) and EMBASE (1988 to present).

Search ClinicalTrials.gov using terms: (bile duct) OR CBD OR choledocholithiasis OR cholelithiasis AND (predict OR rule OR score OR model OR value OR risk OR scoring systems OR algorithm OR validation OR stratification).

Search World Health Organization International Clinical Trials Platform Search Portal (ICTRP) using terms: ((bile duct) OR CBD OR choledocholithiasis OR cholelithiasis) AND (predict OR rule OR score OR model OR value OR risk OR scoring systems OR algorithm OR validation OR stratification).
Apply the detailed MEDLINE (via Ovid) and Embase (via Proquest) search strategies as specified in the Appendix.

steps.title: Perform Manual Search and Author Contact
steps.instruction: Supplement electronic searches with manual identification of studies.

substeps.instruction: Check reference lists of included studies and review articles.
Search reference lists of guidelines related to choledocholithiasis.
Contact authors of identified trials to request additional data.

steps.title: Screen and Select Studies
steps.instruction: Implement a two-stage screening process to select eligible studies.

substeps.instruction: Two review authors (JW and TS) independently screen titles and abstracts, coding them as 'retrieve' (eligible, potentially eligible, or unclear) or 'do not retrieve'.
Retrieve full texts of potentially eligible studies.
Two review authors (JW and TS) independently screen full texts to identify studies for inclusion and record reasons for exclusion.
Resolve disagreements through discussion or consultation with a third author (TK and/or YK).
Exclude duplicates and collate multiple reports of the same study so that each study is the unit of interest.
Document the selection process for a PRISMA flow diagram and 'Characteristics of excluded studies' table.

steps.title: Extract and Manage Data
steps.instruction: Extract study characteristics and outcome data using a standardized approach.

substeps.instruction: Develop a standardized data collection form and pilot it on at least one included study.
Two review authors (JW and TS) independently extract study characteristics.

Extract data in accordance with the Critical Appraisal and Data Extraction for Systematic Reviews (CHARMS) checklist, including: source of data/study design (e.g., prospective, case control, cohort, clinical consensus), study characteristics (e.g., country, year, number of centers), and participant characteristics.
